title: The Goodhart curve, ensembles, and a Lagrangian budget
brief: Compute best-of-n exactly and watch gold fall while the proxy climbs, delay the fall with ensembles, then enforce a cost budget with a Lagrange multiplier and a primal-dual loop.
hints: bon_kl is np.log(n) - (n - 1) / n. Convert n to float first, so integer division cannot creep in.
best_of_n_policy: sort by proxy with np.argsort, take the cumulative sum of the sorted base probabilities, and scatter cdf**n - below**n back with policy[order] = ....
goodhart_curve: for each n, build the best-of-n policy, take sqrt of its KL from the base for d, and dot it with gold and with the proxy.
dual_value is max over arms of (reward - lam * cost), plus lam * budget. It is at least the constrained optimum for every lam >= 0.
In primal_dual, use the p from before the theta update to compute the cost, and average over the second half of the steps. The last iterate swings around the answer; the average lands on it.
